$comment: Hand-labeled from the pinned sample source (scripts/samples.json), not from Concentrate output. gothinkster/spring-boot-realworld-example-app: Spring MVC REST + MyBatis (mapper XML) + DGS GraphQL, SQLite. Scope: src/main/java and src/main/resources; src/test is out of scope (the scan reads it, so a stray finding there would not be scored). Routes: all 19 REST handlers of src/main/java/io/spring/api/*Api.java, one label per method at the line of the mapping annotation; the path is the class-level @RequestMapping joined with the method path (relative paths such as "articles/{slug}/favorite" are served from the root: no servlet context-path is configured, so there is no /api prefix). The GraphQL (DGS) datafetchers are not routes. Imports: every `import io.spring...` of src/main/java (243 lines, read with a regular expression over the import lines and checked for the file on disk). A type of the repository resolves to its file; the nested `CursorPager.Direction` resolves to CursorPager.java; the 47 imports of `io.spring.graphql.types.*` and `io.spring.graphql.DgsConstants.*` name types the DGS codegen generates at build time (no file in the scan), so their target is null. Imports of the JDK and third-party libraries are not labeled (no file in the scan). Injections (scored per consumer file of src/main/java): only injections visible in the source without Lombok are labeled: `@Autowired` constructors and fields and the single constructors. Lombok-generated constructors (`@AllArgsConstructor` on ArticlesApi, ArticleApi, ArticleFavoriteApi, CommentsApi, CurrentUserApi, ProfileApi, TagsApi, UsersApi, the nine *Mutation / *Datafetcher classes of graphql/, ArticleQueryService, CommentQueryService, UserQueryService, TagsQueryService, ProfileQueryService, ArticleCommandService) are a known limitation and are NOT labeled; they are 49 real injection points the scan cannot see (47 with a scanned provider), so recall here is not recall of the app's wiring. Providers are Spring-managed classes with a stereotype: a repository interface injection goes to its one implementing class (UserRepository -> MyBatisUserRepository). Not labeled although true: the `@Mapper` interfaces injected into the MyBatis*Repository classes (an interface with no stereotype is no provider in INJECTS) and `PasswordEncoder` (a @Bean of WebSecurityConfig whose type BCryptPasswordEncoder is not a scanned class). Labeled although the consumer has no stereotype: the four ConstraintValidators (UpdateUserValidator in UserService.java, DuplicatedEmailValidator, DuplicatedUsernameValidator, DuplicatedArticleValidator), which Spring's SpringConstraintValidatorFactory autowires, and JwtTokenFilter, which WebSecurityConfig.jwtTokenFilter() registers as a @Bean (Spring autowires the fields of @Bean instances). Data access: every SQL statement of the MyBatis mapper XML (src/main/resources/mapper/*.xml, `<include refid>` fragments expanded by hand, including the cross-namespace one of CommentReadService) attached to the method of its mapper interface, one label per (method, table, operation) with the model being the table name; operation by SQL verb (select = read; a select whose list is only aggregate functions over one table, e.g. `select count(1) from t where ...`, = aggregate). There are no annotated statements. The repository / service / controller functions that call a mapper are indirect accesses (the harness scores only a function's own accesses) and are not labeled. Env: there is no System.getenv, no @Value placeholder naming an environment variable and no ${NAME} in application.properties, so the env list is empty (the @Value keys image.default, jwt.secret and jwt.sessionTime are Spring config keys, not process environment). SqlTables: the seven tables of db/migration/V1__create_tables.sql, columns in DDL order (SQLite types as written, lowercased). Calls: every call site of the 8 files Article.java, User.java, ArticleCommandService.java, UserService.java (with its UpdateUserValidator) and the four MyBatis*Repository.java whose callee is a method, constructor or `this(...)` written in the repository (checked by reading each file); Lombok-generated getters (getId, getTitle, ...), equals and the JDK, Joda, Spring and validation APIs are not labeled. The method reference `Tag::new` has callee `new` and runs Tag(String). A call through an interface (userRepository.save, articleRepository.save, ...) is labeled with the implementing method only (MyBatisUserRepository.save): the interface method is a declaration with no body, so the call dispatches to the implementation; a scan that also reports the interface declaration is scored a false positive. A mapper call (userMapper.findById) targets the mapper interface method, the only declaration there is (MyBatis generates the implementation at run time).
